plan.goal: Generate point centroids for each building polygon feature and save the result as a Shapefile.
plan.notes: Compute geometric centroids for all polygon features. Output must be a valid point Shapefile in EPSG:4326.

plan.goal: Extract elevation values from the DEM raster at each building centroid location and save the updated features.
plan.notes: Sample raster values from psu_dem at the point coordinates. Add extracted elevation values as a new attribute column. Handle nodata value 0.0 appropriately.

plan.goal: Export the extracted elevation data to a CSV file for histogram plotting.
plan.notes: Extract building ID and elevation columns. Export to CSV format to enable Seaborn histogram plotting with 50 bins. Filter out any nodata or null elevation values before export.
